Rahul Gandhi booked; RSS chief's US visit sparks protests

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has been booked under the SC/ST Act in Uttarakhand following his alleged 'casteist' remarks during a 'purification' ritual. Gandhi had reportedly demanded an FIR over the ritual. Meanwhile, RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat's visit to New York has drawn protests from groups concerned about Hindu nationalism. New York City official Zohran Mamdani expressed opposition to the RSS event but stated he was unsure of his jurisdiction to cancel it.
